changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE app.Communications DROP CONSTRAINT CK_Communications_AudienceType;

ALTER TABLE app.Communications ADD CONSTRAINT CK_Communications_AudienceType CHECK (AudienceType IN (N'AllMembers', N'ActiveMembers', N'ExpiringMembers', N'MembershipPackage', N'TrainerMembers', N'SelectedMembers', N'AllTrainers', N'AllStaff', N'AllBusinessUsers', N'SelectedTrainers', N'SelectedStaff'));

CREATE TABLE app.CommunicationAudienceTargets ( Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, TenantId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, CommunicationId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, TargetKind NVARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, EntityId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, CreatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, UpdatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, DeletedAt DATETIME2 NULL, CreatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, UpdatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, RowVersion ROWVERSION NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_CommunicationAudienceTargets PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_CommunicationAudienceTargets_Communications FOREIGN KEY (CommunicationId) REFERENCES app.Communications (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_CommunicationAudienceTargets_Tenants FOREIGN KEY (TenantId) REFERENCES app.Tenants (Id), CONSTRAINT CK_CommunicationAudienceTargets_Kind CHECK (TargetKind IN (N'Trainer', N'Staff')) ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_CommunicationAudienceTargets_CommunicationId_Kind_EntityId ON app.CommunicationAudienceTargets (CommunicationId, TargetKind, EntityId) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL; CREATE INDEX IX_CommunicationAudienceTargets_TenantId_CommunicationId ON app.CommunicationAudienceTargets (TenantId, CommunicationId) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL;
CREATE TABLE app.CommunicationRecipients ( Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, TenantId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, CommunicationId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, UserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, RecipientKind NVARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, RecipientEntityId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, DeliveredAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, ReadAt DATETIME2 NULL, CreatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, UpdatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, DeletedAt DATETIME2 NULL, CreatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, UpdatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, RowVersion ROWVERSION NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_CommunicationRecipients PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_CommunicationRecipients_Communications FOREIGN KEY (CommunicationId) REFERENCES app.Communications (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_CommunicationRecipients_Users FOREIGN KEY (UserId) REFERENCES app.Users (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_CommunicationRecipients_Tenants FOREIGN KEY (TenantId) REFERENCES app.Tenants (Id), CONSTRAINT CK_CommunicationRecipients_Kind CHECK (RecipientKind IN (N'Member', N'Trainer', N'Staff', N'BusinessUser')) ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_CommunicationRecipients_CommunicationId_UserId ON app.CommunicationRecipients (CommunicationId, UserId) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL; CREATE INDEX IX_CommunicationRecipients_TenantId_UserId_ReadAt ON app.CommunicationRecipients (TenantId, UserId, ReadAt) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL;

INSERT INTO app.RolePermissions (RoleId, PermissionId) SELECT r.Id, p.Id FROM app.Roles r JOIN app.Permissions p ON p.Code = N'COMMUNICATION_READ' WHERE r.Name = N'Trainer' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app.RolePermissions existing WHERE existing.RoleId = r.Id AND existing.PermissionId = p.Id);
